title: Browser reconnect adds a random spread of up to 1 s (row 9 gap G-9-1)
reference_behaviour: The browser's reconnect delay gets a random spread of up to one second, so many open tabs do not reconnect in the same second (bundle-findings 6.1).
ours: Built in bf59ec1f as REQ-113 AC-10: every browser reconnect wait adds a random spread of up to 1 s (frontend/src/composables/useStrategyLive.js, reconnectWait). Was: a flat 1 s for 30 attempts, so every open tab reconnected at once.
